cohort: 160 neonates born to GDM mothers aged 18 and above, experiencing singleton pregnancies, diagnosed with GDM, and maintaining regular follow-up.
finding: Metformin, alone or with insulin, demonstrated comparable neonatal outcomes to insulin in GDM mothers, with the Metformin group showing lower odds of preterm birth, NICU admission, neonatal hypoglycemia, and seizures, but higher odds of LGA and Apgar score <7 compared to the diet-only group.
mod_finding: The Metformin, Insulin, and Metformin + Insulin groups had significantly higher odds of Cesarean section compared to the diet-only group.
birth_weight: Measured (outcomes included Large for Gestational Age (LGA) and Appropriate for Gestational Age (AGA))
